title: Master of Social Work (MSW)
eligibility: Bachelor degree in any discipline with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I candidates).
overview: Specializations in Community Development, Medical & Psychiatric Social Work, and Human Resource Management (HRM). Includes intensive concurrent field work practice and block placement.
outcomes: Prepares professional social workers for NGOs, healthcare institutions, corporate CSR, mental health centers, and community outreach organizations.

title: M.Sc. Chemistry (Organic & General)
eligibility: B.Sc degree with Chemistry as a major/optional subject securing minimum 45% aggregate in Chemistry (40% for SC/ST).
overview: Advanced curriculum in Organic Synthesis, Reaction Mechanisms, Spectroscopic Methods, Spectroscopy, Physical Chemistry, and Pharmaceutical Chemistry with state-of-the-art instrumentation lab.
outcomes: Equips graduates for careers in R&D laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, chemical industries, CSIR-NET research, and academia.

title: M.Sc. Physics
eligibility: B.Sc degree with Physics and Mathematics as optional subjects securing minimum 45% aggregate in Physics.
overview: Covers Quantum Mechanics, Classical Electrodynamics, Solid State Physics, Nuclear & Particle Physics, Statistical Mechanics, and Astrophysics with hands-on computational physics projects.
outcomes: Prepares students for GATE/NET competitive exams, ISRO/DRDO research assistantships, industrial optics, and doctoral programs.

title: M.Sc. Mathematics
eligibility: B.Sc degree with Mathematics as optional/major subject securing minimum 45% aggregate marks.
overview: Rigorous training in Real & Complex Analysis, Abstract Algebra, Differential Equations, Topology, Numerical Analysis, and Functional Analysis.
outcomes: Develops analytical skills for data science, financial modeling, cryptography, actuarial sciences, and higher mathematics research.

title: M.Sc. Computer Science
eligibility: B.Sc in Computer Science / BCA / B.Sc with Mathematics as one of the subjects with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Focused on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Advanced Algorithms, Data Structures, Cyber Security, and Full-Stack Software Engineering.
outcomes: Prepares graduates for roles as AI Engineers, Software Architects, Cloud Solutions Specialists, and Systems Analysts.

title: M.Sc. Biochemistry
eligibility: B.Sc with Biochemistry / Chemistry / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Sciences with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Explores Enzymology, Clinical Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Immunology, Biochemical Techniques, Structural Biology, and Bioinformatics.
outcomes: Prepares professionals for clinical diagnostic labs, biotech firms, clinical trials, and biological science research institutes.

title: Master of Commerce (M.Com)
eligibility: B.Com / BBA degree with minimum 45% aggregate marks from a recognized university.
overview: Specialization in Advanced Corporate Accounting, Business Taxation, Financial Markets, Security Analysis, International Finance, and Corporate Governance.
outcomes: Graduates excel in CA/CS professional paths, banking, investment management, corporate taxation, and financial auditing.

title: M.A. English Literature
eligibility: BA degree with English as optional/major subject securing minimum 45% aggregate in English.
overview: Covers British Literature, Postcolonial Studies, American Literature, Indian Writing in English, Literary Criticism & Theory, and Cultural Studies.
outcomes: Enables careers in publishing, journalism, content strategy, academic teaching, civil services, and literary research.

title: M.A. Economics
eligibility: BA / B.Sc degree with Economics as optional/major subject with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Advanced Micro & Macroeconomics, Econometrics, Public Economics, Development Economics, International Trade, and Applied Economic Analysis.
outcomes: Prepares economists for policy research institutes, banking, economic advisory, data analytics, and government statistical services.

title: M.Sc. Criminology and Forensic Science
eligibility: Bachelor degree in Science / Criminology / Law / Forensic Science / Medicine with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Comprehensive training in Forensic Chemistry, Ballistics, Questioned Documents, Cyber Forensics, Criminal Law, Victimology, and Crime Scene Investigation.
outcomes: Qualifies students for positions in forensic science laboratories, law enforcement agencies, private investigation, and cyber crime units.

title: M.A. Journalism & Mass Communication
eligibility: Bachelor degree in any discipline with minimum 45% aggregate marks.
overview: Print Journalism, Broadcast Media, Digital Media Production, Advertising, Public Relations, Media Ethics, Development Communication, and Film Studies.
outcomes: Prepares reporters, editors, news anchors, digital media strategists, PR officers, and documentary filmmakers.

title: M.Sc. Psychology
eligibility: BA / B.Sc in Psychology or Bachelor degree in any discipline with Psychology as optional with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Advanced Cognitive Psychology, Clinical Assessment, Psychotherapy, Organizational Psychology, Neuropsychology, and Counseling Interventions.
outcomes: Prepares clinical counselors, HR behavioral specialists, school psychologists, and mental health consultants.

title: M.Sc. Food Science and Nutrition
eligibility: B.Sc in Food Science / Home Science / Nutrition / Biochemistry / Biotechnology with minimum 45% aggregate.
overview: Food Chemistry, Clinical Nutrition, Food Processing & Preservation, Quality Control, Clinical Dietetics, and Food Safety Regulations.
outcomes: Careers in food processing companies, hospital clinical nutrition, FSSAI auditing, and public health nutrition initiatives.

title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
eligibility: BCA / B.Sc (CS/IT) or Graduate with Mathematics at 10+2 level with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories).
overview: AICTE & UGC approved program covering Enterprise Software Engineering, Database Systems, Web Technologies, Mobile App Development, DevOps, and Cloud Infrastructure.
outcomes: Produces senior software developers, full-stack engineers, cloud architects, and IT project managers.

title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
eligibility: Bachelor degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories) and valid entrance test rank.
overview: AICTE approved program with dual specializations in Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, and Business Analytics with corporate internships.
outcomes: Prepares corporate executives, business managers, financial analysts, marketing directors, and entrepreneurs.
